##: China edition of Qoder from qoder.com.cn; the build published from qoder.com is a different product.
The vendor only links a stable 'latest' URL; this manifest uses the timestamped path .../releases/<version>/Qoder-CN-win-x64-user.exe so cached downloads stay tied to one version.
Version and SHA-256 are read from the electron-updater feed .../releases/latest.yml, so checkver and the autoupdate hash never download the 257 MiB installer.
The NSIS installer embeds the app as $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; the installer script expands it into $dir, which produces the flat Electron layout with "Qoder CN.exe" at the root.
This is the per-user (win-x64-user) package that the download page serves; win-x64-system is a separate artifact.
description: Agent workbench for human and AI software teams (China edition)
notes: The installer stubs ($PLUGINSDIR, $R8 uninstaller, uninstallerIcon.ico) are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
The bundled electron-updater stays enabled and downloads updates into "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\qoder-cn-updater".
